about: Corresponding source of the GPL FFmpeg builds the app bundles, pinned by URL, byte size and SHA-256 (same entry shape as platform/windows/build-deps.json, always with an empty 'files' list). Two platforms may pin the very same tarball (same file name, URL and SHA-256); the tool then fetches and attaches it once. tools/fetch_ffmpeg_source.py downloads each tarball, refuses any mismatch and names it for attaching to a GitHub release (docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md, step 'Attach the FFmpeg source'). 'builds' says which bundled binaries the source belongs to.

deps.name: ffmpeg-source-windows
deps.hash_source: computed from the download; the detached signature https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz.asc verified Good against FFmpeg release signing key FCF9 86EA 15E6 E293 A564 4F10 B432 2F04 D676 58D8 on 2026-10-09; the gyan.dev build names commit 946fcce07b, which GitHub's compare API reports identical to tag n9.0.2
deps.builds: Windows ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe: gyan.dev essentials build 9.0.2 (platform/windows/build-deps.json)
